title: atractylis chinensis f. simplicifolia
intro: Atractylis chinensis f. simplicifolia, commonly known as the simplified Chinese thistle, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and improving digestion. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, such as atractylodin, and other compounds like flavonoids and saponins. Atractylis chinensis f. simplicifolia has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various ailments, including gastrointestinal issues and arthritis.
